title: CLARITY Act BLOCKED | Bitcoin Slides + Fed Decision Today
description: The CLARITY Act failed to advance in the Senate, Bitcoin is under pressure, and the Federal Reserve is expected to make a major rate decision today. On W3BC LIVE we're breaking down what happened in Washington, what it means for crypto regulation, the market reaction, Robinhood's push to add voting rights and share redemptions to tokenized stocks, the continued growth of RWAs and stablecoin infrastructure, and OpenAI's reported $1.2 trillion valuation talks. Plus NFL Week 2, UFC, boxing and The Trenches. GM. Get Money. 1% Better Every Day.

newsStories.headline: THE BIG STORY · SENATE BLOCKS CLARITY ACT
newsStories.dek: The landmark crypto market-structure bill failed to advance in the Senate.
newsStories.body: Today's digest leads with reports from NBC News, The New York Times and Bloomberg that the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act after Democrats raised concerns including President Trump's crypto interests. The procedural setback is a major loss for an industry that has spent years pushing Congress for clearer federal market-structure rules.
points: SEC / CFTC JURISDICTION · STILL A CORE QUESTION
newsStories.takeaway: CRYPTO ASKED WASHINGTON FOR CLEAR RULES. TODAY THE STORY IS WHAT HAPPENS AFTER CONGRESS FAILED TO DELIVER THEM.
newsStories.source: NBC News / New York Times / Bloomberg / NPR / PBS via Sep 16 digest

newsStories.headline: BITCOIN TAKES THE HIT · ETF OUTFLOWS RETURN
newsStories.dek: BTC sold off around the CLARITY setback with spot ETF outflows also back in focus.
newsStories.body: Today's digest reports Bitcoin falling below $76,000 after the Senate setback, with one alert citing $450.4 million in U.S. Bitcoin ETF outflows. Other coverage in the digest describes Bitcoin falling toward $77,000 ahead of the vote and below $75,000 as the CLARITY effort stumbled.
newsStories.takeaway: THIS IS WHERE POLICY STOPS BEING A WASHINGTON STORY AND STARTS SHOWING UP ON THE CHART.
newsStories.source: Bitcoin Foundation / CryptoSlate / Yahoo Finance / Forbes via Sep 16 digest

newsStories.headline: FED DAY · RATE HIKE EXPECTED
newsStories.dek: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise borrowing costs today for the first time since 2023.
newsStories.body: The digest highlights NBC News, Kiplinger and CBS News coverage saying the Federal Reserve under Chair Kevin Warsh is expected to raise interest rates Wednesday as energy prices keep inflation elevated and the labor market remains steady.
points: INFLATION · ENERGY PRICES REMAIN A PROBLEM
BTC + RISK ASSETS · WATCH THE REACTION
newsStories.takeaway: CRYPTO JUST TOOK A POLICY HIT AND NOW IT HAS TO GET THROUGH FED DAY.
newsStories.source: NBC News / Kiplinger / CBS News via Sep 16 digest

newsStories.headline: RWA WATCH · TOKENIZED ASSETS KEEP EXPANDING
newsStories.dek: The tokenization buildout continues despite the Washington setback.
newsStories.body: Today's digest includes an estimate that tokenized real-world assets have reached $46.7 billion as of September 2026, plus renewable-energy RWA projects and continued expansion of tokenized-stock access. Treat the $46.7 billion figure as the reporting source's estimate rather than a universal market-size standard.
newsStories.takeaway: THE LEGISLATION STALLED. THE TOKENIZATION TREND DIDN'T.
newsStories.source: Pluang / Fidelity Investments / Yahoo Finance via Sep 16 digest

robinhoodStories.headline: ROBINHOOD CORNER · OWNERSHIP FEATURES MOVE ONCHAIN
robinhoodStories.dek: Robinhood plans voting rights and share redemptions for tokenized stocks.
robinhoodStories.body: Today's digest again highlights Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev's plan to add share redemptions and voting rights to tokenized stocks. Coinbase is also adding voting rights to tokenized stock offerings. The important shift is from simple price exposure toward products carrying more of the rights associated with traditional ownership.
robinhoodStories.takeaway: THE QUESTION ISN'T WHETHER STOCKS CAN BE TOKENIZED ANYMORE. IT'S WHAT RIGHTS THE TOKEN ACTUALLY GIVES YOU.
robinhoodStories.source: Yahoo Finance / TradingView via Sep 16 digest

robinhoodStories.headline: TOKENIZED STOCKS · ACCESS IS EXPANDING FAST
robinhoodStories.dek: Wallets and platforms are pushing tokenized equities toward a much larger audience.
robinhoodStories.body: The digest highlights reporting that tokenized stocks now represent around 15 percent of the still-small RWA market, while Bitget Wallet announced integration with Reality to provide access to more than 1,700 tokenized stocks and ETFs for its user base.
points: TOKENIZED STOCKS · REPORTED 15% OF RWA MARKET
LIQUIDITY AT SIZE · STILL A CHALLENGE
robinhoodStories.takeaway: ACCESS IS GETTING EASIER. THE NEXT TEST IS WHETHER LIQUIDITY AND LEGAL RIGHTS CATCH UP.
robinhoodStories.source: Traders Magazine / Markets Insider via Sep 16 digest

aiStories.headline: AI DESK · OPENAI AT $1.2 TRILLION?
aiStories.dek: OpenAI has reportedly discussed a new funding round at a roughly $1.2 trillion valuation.
aiStories.body: Reuters is highlighted in today's digest reporting that OpenAI has held discussions with large investors about a fresh capital raise that could increase the company's valuation to about $1.2 trillion. Another alert says OpenAI has ruled out a 2026 IPO, while Anthropic is separately reported to be moving toward a Nasdaq listing.
aiStories.takeaway: A TRILLION-DOLLAR PRIVATE AI COMPANY WOULD HAVE SOUNDED INSANE A FEW YEARS AGO. NOW IT'S A REAL CAPITAL-MARKETS CONVERSATION.
aiStories.source: Reuters / Yahoo Finance / Quartz via Sep 16 digest

sportsStories.headline: NFL · WEEK 2 IS HERE
sportsStories.body: NFL.com's Week 2 power rankings move Seattle into the No. 1 spot, while ESPN's latest intel turns toward Week 2 buzz, fantasy questions and early-season adjustments.
sportsStories.takeaway: ONE WEEK IS ENOUGH FOR EVERY NFL FAN TO COMPLETELY REWRITE THEIR PRESEASON THESIS.

sportsStories.headline: UFC · MOKAEV WANTS BACK IN
sportsStories.body: BBC Sport reports Muhammad Mokaev is vowing to return to the UFC after his controversial release despite seven straight wins. Dana White's Contender Series also continues producing new contract winners.
sportsStories.takeaway: WINNING ISN'T ALWAYS THE ONLY THING THAT DETERMINES WHO STAYS IN THE UFC.
sportsStories.source: BBC Sport / UFC.com via Sep 16 digest

sportsStories.headline: BOXING / GOLF QUICK HITS
sportsStories.body: The digest has continued discussion around Conor Benn's comeback and the Tyson Fury-Anthony Joshua saga. In golf, PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp says there are no plans for an instant return pathway for LIV Golf's biggest stars.
points: PGA TOUR · NO INSTANT LIV RETURN PATH
sportsStories.takeaway: KEEP THESE QUICK. THEY'RE CONVERSATION STARTERS, NOT THE A-STORY.
sportsStories.source: Sky Sports / DAZN / BBC Sport via Sep 16 digest
